payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation, detailing both section title embedding and classified section title embedding.

claims.text: Section titles are encoded using section title embedding (STE) by summing the last hidden states of tokenized section titles, creating a single embedding.
Classified section title embedding (classified STE) replaces intraclass STEs with the embedding of their corresponding class, while original STE is used for titles that do not fit any class.
The paper groups similar section titles into classes to enhance the encoding process, treating titles with similar meanings as belonging to the same class.
